Remove the malformed fragments and retain the single complete ItemAttention definition and constructor.","code_summary":"One independently trained candidate-conditioned ItemAttention network per category. History and candidate embeddings share one table; learned key/query projections, recency-decayed attention, normalized context similarity, and jointly learned item biases produce scores. The predictor writer reconstructs the same architecture and routes each category to exactly one checkpoint; no ensemble is used."}
